user.title: Even Realities G1
user.description: Create an entry for your G1 glasses. Afterwards connect the Even G1 companion app on your phone to Home Assistant and select this entry.

abort.already_configured: Glasses with this name are already configured.

data.show_transcript: Show recognized question on the glasses

data_description.assist_pipeline: Answers when you hold the left touch bar. Also selectable with the "Assistant" entity of the device.
data_description.auto_gain: Boosts quiet speech (0 = off, 31 = max). Helps if questions are often not understood.
data_description.noise_suppression: 0 = off, 4 = strong. Helps in noisy surroundings.
data_description.dashboard_gesture: With "Head up" the app shows the template as soon as you look up, on top of the Even dashboard, and closes it when you look down.
data_description.dashboard_entities: Shown as "Name: state" lines on the glasses dashboard, in this order.
data_description.dashboard_calendars: Appointments of today (not yet over) and tomorrow appear on the dashboard.
data_description.dashboard_todos: Open to-dos with a due date appear on the dashboard, the most urgent first.
data_description.dashboard_template: Empty = built-in layout: time and date, entities, appointments and to-dos on one page. A template replaces the layout below the entities and can use the variables kopfzeile, agenda and agenda_mehr.
